description: Add Supabase integration to persist workout sessions, sets, and rep data. Only final results (rep counts, set data, duration) are sent to Supabase - no video streaming. Include database schema documentation and a configured Supabase client.
steps: Add to package.json dependencies: '@supabase/supabase-js': '^2.39.0', 'react-native-url-polyfill': '^2.0.0' (needed for Supabase in React Native).

Create services/supabase.js - Initialize Supabase client with placeholder URL and anon key (users will replace with their own project credentials). Export the client instance. Include comments documenting the expected environment setup. Use react-native-url-polyfill/auto import at top.

Create services/workoutService.js - Service layer with functions: (1) saveWorkoutSession({exerciseId, exerciseName, totalDuration, totalReps, sets, startedAt, completedAt}) -> inserts into 'workout_sessions' table and returns the session ID, (2) getWorkoutHistory(limit=20) -> fetches recent workout sessions ordered by date, (3) getExerciseStats(exerciseId) -> fetches aggregate stats for a specific exercise (total reps, sessions count, best set). Each function includes proper error handling and returns {data, error} pattern.

Create services/database.sql - SQL schema file documenting the Supabase tables to create: (1) workout_sessions table with columns: id (uuid, pk), user_id (uuid, fk to auth.users), exercise_id (text), exercise_name (text), total_duration_seconds (integer), total_reps (integer), sets (jsonb - array of {setNumber, reps, duration}), started_at (timestamptz), completed_at (timestamptz), created_at (timestamptz, default now()). (2) Add RLS policies for user_id = auth.uid().

Update screens/WorkoutSummaryScreen.js to call saveWorkoutSession when the user taps 'Save Workout'. Show a loading spinner during save, success confirmation with a checkmark animation, and error state with retry option. After successful save, offer to navigate back to home.

Update screens/HomeScreen.js to show recent workout history: add a 'Recent AI Workouts' section below the Weekly Progress that calls getWorkoutHistory and shows the last 3-5 sessions with exercise name, reps, and date. Handle empty state gracefully with a 'Start your first AI workout' prompt.
acceptance_criteria: services/supabase.js exports a configured Supabase client (with placeholder credentials clearly marked)
services/workoutService.js exports saveWorkoutSession, getWorkoutHistory, and getExerciseStats functions
services/database.sql contains complete table creation SQL with RLS policies
WorkoutSummaryScreen saves workout data on button press with loading/success/error states
HomeScreen displays recent AI workout history section
All .js files pass node --check syntax validation
No video or image data is included in the Supabase payload - only numeric results
verification: Run 'export NODE_OPTIONS="" && node --check services/supabase.js && node --check services/workoutService.js && node --check screens/WorkoutSummaryScreen.js && node --check screens/HomeScreen.js' from /projects/sandbox/snack
Verify services/database.sql exists and contains CREATE TABLE statements
Run 'export NODE_OPTIONS="" && node -e "const ws = require('./services/workoutService'); console.log(typeof ws.saveWorkoutSession === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');"' from /projects/sandbox/snack
